parsed.name: 多通道标量计数器
parsed.description: 一种实验室计数仪器，用于在设定时间窗口内同时累计多路脉冲信号的计数值。常用于束线和通用实验系统中读取电离室、光子计数器等探测器输出，并进行同步计数与通道监测。
parsed.description_en: A laboratory counting instrument that accumulates pulse counts from multiple input channels within a defined counting interval. It is commonly used in beamlines and general lab setups to read outputs from ion chambers, photon counters, and similar detectors for synchronized counting and channel monitoring.
